evidence: log loss +0.0132 (95% interval +0.0051 to +0.0211). The model's probabilities are WORSE than the market's closing probabilities (the interval is above zero).

380 picks, ROI -1.2% (95% interval -8.3% to +5.9%), win rate 58.7% against a break-even 58.9%. Random sides at the same margin match or beat this 30% of the time. Line movement toward the pick after it was made: +0.12 probability points on average (zero means no closing-line value).
How many bets before ROI can be trusted

At the observed spread of results, detecting a true 3% ROI takes about 4,910 bets and a 5% ROI about 1,768; a 1% edge takes 44,190. Closing-line value converges much faster, which is why it is the primary measure.
